body.p: Claims 1-15 are pending in the application. Claims 1 and 15 are amended to round out the scope of the invention. No new matter is added.

Applicants appreciate the Examiner's acknowledgment of allowable subject matter of claim 15. To expedite examination, Applicants amended claim 1 to incorporate the allowable subject matter. In addition, claim 15 has been amended to remove the distal and proximal limitations to round out the scope of the invention. Applicants respectfully submit that the amendments do not affect the claim's allowability.

Applicants believe the application is now in condition for allowance and respectfully requests a notice to that effect. Should the Examiner believe that any additional minor amendment to the claims be made to place the application in even better condition for allowance, the Examiner is cordially invited to telephone the attorney of record identified below.
The undersigned representative requests any extension of time that may be deemed

necessary to further the prosecution of this application. The undersigned representative authorizes the Commissioner to charge any additional fees under 37 C.F.R. 1.16 or 1.17 that may be required, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No.: 23-2185 under Order No. 200380-00286.
